title: The 23rd Ghost Army Deception
hook: Artists fooled the German high command with rubber tanks.

scenes.text: In 1944, the US Army created the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops: a top-secret unit made of artists, designers, and sound engineers.

scenes.voicedText: In 1944, the US Army created the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops: a top-secret unit made of artists, designers, and sound engineers.

scenes.text: Their mission wasn't to fight, but to simulate entire thirty-thousand-man armored divisions where no real troops existed.

scenes.text: They inflated life-size rubber Sherman tanks and artillery guns with air compressors in under thirty minutes.
